links.outcome: Missed ground-truth diagnoses with and without RAG grounding
links.effect: Top models missed 0.5% of ground truth conditions clearly inferable from data; RAG further improved this error rate to 0.2%.
links.quote: We found that GPT-4o from OpenAI and Claude Sonnet 3.5 from Anthropic were the top performers with them only missing 0.5% of ground truth conditions that were clearly inferable from the available data; RAG further improved this error rate to 0.2%.

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: Evaluates multiple LLMs on a real-patient cohort dataset for diagnosis, and specifically tests the impact of adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to improve accuracy.
